Focusing on singing, another group of psychologists reviewed articles on the efficacy of group singing as a mental health treatment for individuals living with a mental health condition in a community setting. The findings showed that, when people with mental health conditions participated in a choir, their mental health and wellbeing significantly improved. Group singing provided enjoyment, improved emotional states, developed a sense of belonging and __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: enhanced self-confidence(자신감을 높였다) — 집단 노래의 긍정적 효과
det.analysis:
✅ ① enhanced self-confidence(자신감을 높였다): 'provided enjoyment, ... developed a sense of belonging and ______'에서 집단 노래가 자신감을 높였다는 긍정적 효과 나열의 마무리 ←정답

❌ ② increased their anxiety(불안을 키웠다): 긍정적 효과 나열과 반대

❌ ③ created serious conflicts(심각한 갈등을 만들었다): 긍정적 효과와 반대

❌ ④ reduced their motivation(동기를 떨어뜨렸다): 긍정적 효과와 반대
det.tip: enhanced self-confidence = 자신감을 높였다

questions.passage: A group of psychologists studied individuals with severe mental illness who experienced weekly group music therapy, including __________. The results showed that the group music therapy improved the quality of participants' life, with those participating in a greater number of sessions experiencing the greatest benefits. Focusing on singing, another group of psychologists reviewed articles on the efficacy of group singing as a mental health treatment for individuals living with a mental health condition in a community setting. The findings showed that, when people with mental health conditions participated in a choir, their mental health and wellbeing significantly improved. Group singing provided enjoyment, improved emotional states, developed a sense of belonging and enhanced self-confidence.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 영어를 쓰시오.
친숙한 노래를 부르고 독창적인 노래를 작곡하기
[조건] (1) and, composing, familiar, original, singing, songs, songs를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 7단어로 쓸 것 (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: singing familiar songs and composing original songs = 친숙한 노래를 부르고 독창적인 노래를 작곡하기
det.analysis: 본문 S1 'including singing familiar songs and composing original songs'에서 발췌. 동명사 singing과 composing이 and로 병렬된다. 7단어: singing/familiar/songs/and/composing/original/songs.
det.tip: 동명사 병렬: singing familiar songs and composing original songs

questions.wa: singing familiar songs and composing original songs
accept: singing familiar songs and composing original songs

questions.passage: The therapy improved the quality of life, with those participating in a greater number of sessions __________ (experience) the greatest benefits. Focusing on singing, another group of psychologists reviewed articles on the efficacy of group singing as a mental health treatment for individuals living with a mental health condition in a community setting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: with + those + V-ing(부대상황)에서 현재분사 → experiencing
det.analysis: 'with + 명사 + 분사'의 부대상황 구문으로, those(사람들)가 '경험하는' 능동 관계이므로 현재분사 experiencing이 와야 한다. with those ... experiencing the greatest benefits = 그들이 가장 큰 이점을 경험하면서.
det.tip: with + O + V-ing: those ... experiencing ~

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 영어를 쓰시오.
정신 건강 질환을 안고 살아가는 사람들
[조건] (1) a, condition, health, individuals, living, mental, with를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 7단어로 쓸 것 (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: individuals living with a mental health condition = 정신 건강 질환을 안고 살아가는 사람들
det.analysis: 본문 S3 'individuals living with a mental health condition'에서 발췌. 명사 individuals를 현재분사구 living with ~가 뒤에서 수식한다. live with ~ = ~을 안고 살다. 7단어: individuals/living/with/a/mental/health/condition.
det.tip: 명사 + 현재분사 수식: individuals living with ~ = ~을 안고 사는 사람들

questions.wa: individuals living with a mental health condition
accept: individuals living with a mental health condition

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
정신 건강 질환이 있는 사람들이 합창단에 참여했을 때
[조건] (1) a, choir, conditions, health, in, mental, participated, people, when, with를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 10단어로 쓸 것 (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: when people with mental health conditions participated in a choir = 정신 건강 질환이 있는 사람들이 합창단에 참여했을 때
det.analysis: 본문 S4 'when people with mental health conditions participated in a choir'와 일치. 접속사 when + 주어(people with mental health conditions) + 동사(participated) + in a choir. 10단어.
det.tip: when + 주어 + 과거동사: when people ... participated in a choir

questions.stem:

정신 건강 치료법으로서의 집단 노래의 효능
[조건] (1) a, as, efficacy, group, health, mental, of, singing, the, treatment를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 10단어로 쓸 것 (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: the efficacy of group singing as a mental health treatment = 정신 건강 치료법으로서의 집단 노래의 효능
det.analysis: 본문 S3 'the efficacy of group singing as a mental health treatment'에서 발췌. the efficacy of A(A의 효능) + as B(B로서). 10단어: the/efficacy/of/group/singing/as/a/mental/health/treatment.
det.tip: the efficacy of ~ as ... = ...로서의 ~의 효능
